results.title: Exposure providers bootstrapped with approval; tool cards honest; re-run idempotent

tools.name: Cockpit
tools.note: Existing Cockpit installation bound without changes. Listener on port 9090 as configured by the host. Log in with an OS account. Login page reachable (HTTP 200). Uses a self-signed certificate; your browser will ask you to trust it.

tools.name: Portainer
tools.note: Portainer CE 2.39.7 with Docker socket access (root-equivalent). First run: create the admin in Portainer's own form within 5 minutes of start; it asks for the one-time setup token printed in the container log (sudo docker logs hb_platform_portainer-portainer-1 2>&1 | grep setup_token). If the window expired, run: sudo docker restart hb_platform_portainer-portainer-1 (prints a new token). Self-signed certificate. Login page reachable (HTTP 200). Uses a self-signed certificate; your browser will ask you to trust it.
